findings.title: $__range queries are interpolated before the no-split guard
findings.body: runSplitQuery now calls datasource.applyTemplateVariables before querySupportsSplitting. That helper skips splitting when the expression still contains a range variable, because $__range / $__range_ms / $__range_s must be interpolated against each split window (the comment says the backend does this with the split time range). Template replacement substitutes those macros using the original full request range, so isQueryWithRangeVariable no longer matches and the query is split anyway. Each chunk then runs with the full-range duration already baked in, so range-scoped LogQL returns wrong results.

findings.title: Shard path interpolates queries twice
findings.body: runShardSplitQuery maps every target through datasource.applyTemplateVariables, then splitQueriesByStreamShard builds sub-requests from those already-interpolated targets and passes them to runSplitQuery, which applies applyTemplateVariables again. applyTemplateVariables is not idempotent: it also injects ad-hoc filters and scoped-var replacements, so filters and matchers are appended a second time and any value that itself contains $… can be rewritten again. The updated test expecting applyTemplateVariables to be called 5 times (once up front plus once per shard group) locks in this double application rather than a single interpolation.
